legal.privacyLede: What this app records about your household, why, and what you can do about it. Everything below describes how the app behaves today.
legal.purposesBody: We ask separately for each purpose, and record each answer against the person it concerns. You can turn any non-essential purpose off at any time in Settings, and we stop processing for it straight away.
legal.purposesUnavailable: We could not load the current purposes. They are also listed in Settings under Your privacy choices.
legal.childrenBody: A child's profile is managed by a guardian, who must confirm their relationship and the basis of their authority before a profile is created. For a child we store an age band, allergens and dietary preferences — never a date of birth, and nothing else. We work out results for a child only after a guardian has completed consent for that child.
legal.rightsBody: All three of these are available from Settings, without contacting us.
legal.rightExport: Download a copy of your households, profiles, consent history and contributions as a file.
legal.rightWithdraw: Turn off any non-essential purpose. We stop processing for it immediately.
legal.rightDelete: Delete your account. We remove your profile, your results and your activity, and keep only a record that consent was given and withdrawn and that the deletion happened.
legal.sourcesBody: Product information is drawn from Open Food Facts under the Open Database License and from labels contributed by people using this app. Contributed product data is about the product, not about you, and carries no personal information.
legal.reviewNotice: This notice describes the software's current behaviour and has not yet completed legal review. It is not the final published notice.
legal.termsLede: The short version of what this app is, and what it is not.
legal.termsWhatBody: Information about packaged food products, and how a product compares against goals and allergens you record for the people in your household. It reports what a label declares and explains its reasoning.
legal.termsAccuracyBody: The catalogue is assembled from open data and contributions, so it can be incomplete or out of date, and a manufacturer can reformulate a product at any time. Always read the pack itself before relying on a result, and tell us when something looks wrong.
legal.termsAccountBody: Keep your password to yourself. Records you create for other adults are invitations only — each adult sets up their own account and makes their own privacy choices.
legal.termsContributionsBody: A product you add is reviewed before it appears for other households. Contribute only photographs of product packaging that you took yourself.
auth.legalAgreement: By creating an account you agree to:
